{{Top}}
[[File:Gambler_TofG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] gambler]]
{{Quote|It's not whether you win or lose, just how often.|Herglic gambler, name unknown|<ref name="Heroes & Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>}}
'''Gambling''' had been a popular form of entertainment in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for millennia. Some areas of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] allowed gambling and by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]] introduced legislation to legalize it throughout the entire Republic. Gambling, in fact, proved quite influential in Galactic history.

In particular, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] were fond of games of chance, with the former losing [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] when Anakin was a slave on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] over a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] bet and the latter winning (and later losing) the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] via the game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].

Some [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the Herglics, were especially prone to gambling.
